name: IRD number
note: New Zealand's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: Inland Revenue issues the IRD number on application with proof of identity (an adult in person); it can also be issued when a child's birth is registered online with Internal Affairs (not modelled as the default). Eight or nine digits, a base and a trailing check digit whose rule the sheet doesn't give (`check` left out); eight-digit numbers are increasingly written with a leading 0, so the pattern draws nine. No fee or time is stated.

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, New-Zealand: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
